messages:
Zoe Alvarez: quick post-release pulse  we have 2 customer-facing regressions (signup timeout, billing retry loop), ~10 low-ux items, and 3 enhancement asks from two pilots. decide: bug-week, or split bug+micro-invest?
Priy Shah: +1 for a disciplined bug-first week (4 working days). keep a single micro-invest lane (1 engineer) for a behind-flag small win. minimizes blast radius.
Ethan Brooks: ops note  signup timeout looks like connection pooling under spike. i can land a conservative pool-size bump + telemetry in a single hotfix PR with a 1hr canary.
Rina Kapoor: product POV  we should gate any invest work with: 1) clear customer outcome, 2) measurable success metric, 3) telemetry events + rollback. otherwise push to backlog.
Zoe Alvarez: proposed cadence:
- Mon-Thu: bug-first sprint (hotfix lane for paying-customer regressions)
- Fri: micro-invest (ship only if all gates pass) + retro
Gates to end bug sprint: zero open p0s, smoke tests green, p99 <= baseline *1.10.
Priy Shah: enforcement rule: no feature merges to main during bug sprint unless behind-experiment flag + required telemetry. document in PR template.
Ethan Brooks: canary checklist snippet:
```
- create 5% canary cohort
- run smoke + perf suite (incl. signup path)
- monitor errors and p99
- rollback if error-rate > baseline*2 or p99 > baseline*1.15
```
Rina Kapoor: scoring quicklist (impact x effort): export CSV (low effort, medium impact), context bump (high effort), model pinning UI (medium effort). i'll rank and post later today; export CSV looks like the best candidate for micro-invest.
TriageBot: Created ticket #PROD-8421 for export-CSV behind-flag + telemetry. Priority: medium.
Zoe Alvarez: owners: Ethan -> signup canary + pool bump; Priy -> backlog triage + PR gating; Rina -> pilot ask scoring + feature acceptance. i'll schedule a short sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to lock owners.
Priy Shah: i'll also add a tiny e2e that covers signup -> billing -> streaming so we catch cross-flow regressions early.
Ethan Brooks: noted. will prepare canary PR for Wed 03:00 UTC window.
Zoe Alvarez: action items summarized: Rina posts ranked asks by EOD; Priy updates PR template + enforces no-main merges; Ethan readies canary PR. keep updates in-thread, we'll finalize in the sync. :thumbsup:
